en: A couple gets in your taxi. If you add it up, their total age cannot be more than 40.
es: Una pareja sube a tu taxi. Si sumas sus edades, no llegan a 40 entre los dos.
hint: Una pareja se sube a tu taxi. Entre los dos, apenas suman más de cuarenta.

en: They glance at each other nervously and occasionally grab hands affectionately.

en: He speaks first.
Despite being built like a tank, his voice is soft and a bit hesitant.
